verdict.rationale: The Kimi help center has a section on installing, creating and publishing Kimi plugins and skills. That points to a first-party extension mechanism where plugins can be added to the assistant and published for others. The evidence is only a one-line category title, so a browsable third-party directory is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: an evidenced browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps and connectors, a documented add or connect flow, the scope of available connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant

citations.quote: 插件和技能 安装、创建和发布 Kimi 插件与技能
